dependsOn: sat-engine release (branch claude/sat-engine): SAT Practice app + sat-practice function that render data.passage and the official domains/skills
manualFollowUps: Dependency: push this migration only AFTER the sat-engine release is merged and its SAT Practice frontend and sat-practice Edge Function are live. The code on main today never reads data.passage, and the live select_sat_practice_questions RPC would serve these published grammar/transitions/rhetoric items immediately, so learners would see transitions and conventions questions without their passages (and rhetorical synthesis items without their notes).

Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all only from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus 20261026143000_sat_practice_expression_conventions.sql, keeping the 9 pending payment migrations from #220 (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first, then supabase migration list --linked. Adds two parts under the SAT Practice Reading and Writing section 2dd5a6ad-d4e5-5141-982e-22469816765f (Expression of Ideas, display_order 12; Standard English Conventions, display_order 13) and 200 original questions with answer keys: rhetorical_synthesis 48, transitions 42, boundaries 55, form_structure_and_sense 55. Insert-only, every statement on conflict do nothing; rerunning is a no-op.
Regenerate after any content edit: node scripts/content/sat-rw-b.mjs (and --check to confirm the committed migration matches content/sat-practice/*.json).
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows 20261026143000 applied and the 9 #220 payment migrations still pending.

select p.name, count(u.*) from public.parts p join public.content_units u on u.part_id=p.id where p.id in (md5('schood-sat-part:expression_of_ideas')::uuid, md5('schood-sat-part:standard_english_conventions')::uuid) group by 1 returns Expression of Ideas 90 and Standard English Conventions 110, each with a matching answer_keys row.

In SAT Practice (signed in, after sat-engine is live): a Reading and Writing session filtered to Expression of Ideas or Standard English Conventions shows the passage with its ______ blank, four options, and the explanation after scoring.

rollback.migration: Do not delete (attempts and SRS rows reference content_units). Hide the items instead: update public.content_units set metadata = metadata || '{"content_status":"retired"}'::jsonb where metadata->>'content_revision' = 'original-2026-10-v2' and part_id in (md5('schood-sat-part:expression_of_ideas')::uuid, md5('schood-sat-part:standard_english_conventions')::uuid); the selection RPC skips retired items.
